storyline.real: Mansell's left-rear tyre explodes on lap 64; Prost wins the race and the title
storyline.headline: Mansell makes it to the Adelaide flag and is world champion

mastery.label: Take the title with a precautionary tyre stop

hidden.label: Beat the real result: get the Williams to the flag

eras.briefing: Adelaide, October 1986, the title decider. Mansell has 70 points, Prost 64, Piquet 63: third place makes Mansell champion. Fuel is limited to 195 litres. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times are reconstructed.

storylineRetirements.real: Mansell, third and set for the title, ran on his original set; on lap 64 his left-rear tyre exploded on the Brabham Straight (Rosberg's right rear had failed on lap 63), and Williams then called Piquet in for a precautionary tyre change
